授業概要
https://moodle.s.kyushu-u.ac.jp/course/view.php?id=71043
This semester deals with urban informal communities. By using Doug Saunders' text of "Arrival City", we will discuss the contemporary urban challenges of rural to urban migration on a global scale, especially in terms of social mobility. Particular attention will be given to social and spatial relations within major destination cities.

全体の教育目標
You will get familiar with approaches to urban space and society through the lens of migration. Through these approaches you will acquire flexible insights into the structure and dynamics of, among else, diverse communities and neighborhoods.
個別の教育目標
We will discuss the social relations between slums/squatter areas and the established/formal city in various urban contexts.
授業計画
1. Introduction and background of this course
2. Urban theory: The concept of "Arrival City"
3. Urban spatial structure (1): Migrant neighborhoods in inner-city and outer-city areas
4. Urban spatial structure (2): The formation process of migrant neighborhoods
5. Urban spatial structure (3): The move to migrant cities
6. Rural to urban migration (1): The urbanization of villages
7. Rural to urban migration (2): The first great migration
8. Reflection and Prospects
キーワード
Cities, globalization, migration, urban governance, informality, social exclusion/inclusion
授業の進め方
Classes will be conducted in seminar format with Powerpoint illustrations and video materials. In addition, one class will be designated for fieldwork. Summary handouts will be provided for each class.
テキスト
Reference materials will be provided for each class.
